bifrost: springboard/src/net/ (wifi.rs, wifi_config.rs, wpa.rs, dhcp.rs, wifi_event.rs), springboard/netd/src, springboard/src/shell/pages.rs (PageId::Vpn)
summary: BifrOSt has a system-level Wi-Fi client (wpa_supplicant control, saved networks, DHCP, DNS from the lease written to resolv.conf) but no working app-facing Network Extension API (only a pure hotspot helper model that the system does not drive). There is no VPN client, tunnel, relay, content filter, URL filter, DNS proxy or local push; the VPN settings page is a static placeholder showing Not Connected.

features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. Wave 4 (w4-network-extension, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Saved networks are written as wpa_supplicant blocks with priority ordering (move_network, upsert). Only the shell can use them; no SDK API exposes a join or add-configuration call to apps.

Network name and passphrase checks, the consent rule, the accessory join state and the sign-in helper's command queue and responses are tested headless in tests/parity_sdk-complete-01.rs. Gap: the system radio and supplicant that would deliver commands and join networks do not exist here, the shell does not use these models, and nothing is tested on Midget. Refreshed 2026-10-17: the configuration model (sdk hotspot_configuration) is tested headless in tests/parity_sdk-complete-01.rs.

The profile store (named profiles, unique names without regard to case, one active profile, text form with validation on load) is tested headless in core/tests/parity_sdk-complete-02.rs. The settings page (springboard/src/shell/pages.rs, springboard/src/shell/desktop_network.rs) is shell wiring and not part of this evidence. The VPN & Device Management page is a static placeholder ('VPN' value 'Not Connected'). Gap: no IKEv2 or IPsec client and no keychain for credentials; the store is not yet written to disk by the shell, and the protocol paths need the VM or Midget.

features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 9 tests. Wave 2 (theme-06, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Errors are internal to the Wi-Fi code. No SDK error types for network extensions.

gaps: No VPN tunnel I/O: core tunnel.rs has the session state machine and the profile store (tests tunnel::tests), but no IKEv2, IPsec, WireGuard or packet-tunnel provider moves packets, and the VPN settings page is a static placeholder

No Wi-Fi join or add-network path reaches the radio. The configuration model exists (sdk hotspot_configuration: HotspotConfiguration, validation, consent in apply; tests in tests/parity_sdk-complete-01.rs), but nothing applies it and no app can call it; join and add-network stay shell-only
No content filter, URL filter or DNS proxy extension points for apps.
No system-wide encrypted DNS (DoH or DoT) settings; only DHCP-supplied resolvers are applied.
No network relay (HTTP/2 or HTTP/3 proxying) configuration.
No tethering subsystem. The hotspot helper models (sdk hotspot_helper, accessory_hotspot) have no radio or supplicant behind them
No local push connectivity when the internet is unavailable.
